title: Happy ghast speed upgrade
description: This project adds faster happy ghasts with their speed fully configurable
body:
Tired of super slow happy ghasts? Other mods and data packs make them faster even when nobody is riding them, which makes them look silly when on a leash?

### This mod lets you:
- Customize the **speed of happy ghasts** when players are riding them, and when there aren't, **separately**.

### Confing options are:
- _mount_speed_ : How **fast** they are when **players** ride them
- _default_speed_ : How **fast** they are when **no players** are riding them
